title: Confidence-gated cross-model KV translation with native fallback
hypothesis: For source-to-target cache pairs that failed fixed affine translation, a threshold chosen only on development can use source-KV novelty (no target loss at inference) to select translation or native target prefill, keeping fresh target NLL within +0.5 nat of native while falling back on at most 50% of prompts and beating always-native end-to-end latency.
prior_art_boundary: PA236 shows pair-dependent ridge failures; PA238 uses mixtures plus target-side context correction and reports trajectory failures. This test adds source-only reliability gating and native re-prefill, not a MoT reproduction.

data.exclusions: Exclude Wikitext-2 titles/rows and all selected title/text hashes from MA-883, MA-886 and MA-887.
data.partition: Whole article titles by int(SHA256(title)[:8],16) mod 4; bucket 0 development, buckets 1/2/3 fresh seeds 12889/12893/12899.
data.prompt_alignment: Identical source/target tokenizer character offsets and token counts.
data.split: 24 mapper/calibration fit, 8 development check, 16 heldout prompts per bucket.

fixed_design.mapper: Independent per-source-target affine ridge KV map, layer/head nearest-relative alignment, remove source/target RoPE for fitting and restore target RoPE before replay; alpha 0.01, inherited as prior control from MA-886.
fixed_design.source_only_score: Per prompt, RMS of source key/value vectors over mapped roles and positions, standardized against the corresponding 24-prompt fit-set mean and standard deviation. Gate does not inspect target cache, target logits, labels, or NLL at inference.
fixed_design.gate: If standardized source RMS exceeds frozen development threshold, run native target prefill; otherwise translate. Gate is evaluated independently per target pair.
fixed_design.threshold_selection: Use development check prompts only to select from fixed thresholds [-inf, -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, inf]. Minimize mean per-target path time (translate apply+replay or native target prefill+replay); producer prefill is a shared constant across the two targets and is charged once in final fanout latency. Thresholds must satisfy mean NLL <= native +0.5 nat and fallback fraction <=50%; tie-break by lower NLL, then higher threshold. If none feasible, choose minimum-NLL threshold and record no feasible point.
fixed_design.fresh_fit: Refit each pair map and source RMS normalizer on that fresh bucket fit split; reuse frozen threshold, no fresh retuning.

controls: Native target prefill plus one-token replay
Always translate using independent per-pair ridge map
Source-only confidence gate with native fallback
MA-886 shared global+role-code map reported as historical comparator, not rerun.
success_gate: For both targets aggregated over all three fresh seeds: gated mean NLL <= native +0.5 nat; fallback <=50%; fanout end-to-end mean latency including one source prefill shared across both target handoffs is lower than two always-native target prefills; serialized per-pair mapper plus gate state is <=1% larger than the same independent ridge maps without the gate (this is a reliability-policy experiment, not a map-compression claim).
failure_gate: Any quality, fallback, combined latency, or incremental payload gate fails; or no development threshold meets both the quality/fallback constraints.

compute.hardware: CPU (container capability probe reported torch 2.14.1+cpu, CUDA unavailable)

scope: Two registered source-target pairs, one-token next-token replay, Wikitext-103 article-heldout prompts.
No target-side correction, multi-token rollout, GPU throughput, or general cross-model semantics.

protocol_amendments.reason: Development harness audit found the source prefill was charged once per target in threshold scoring and omitted on native fallback in reported gate latency; correct accounting is one source prefill shared across the two fanout targets, plus either translated replay or native target prefill/replay per target. The initial <=25% mapper-byte criterion was inapplicable because this candidate intentionally uses the registered per-pair ridge maps; replaced with a <=1% incremental gate-state overhead criterion, while reporting full map bytes. Fresh thresholds must use development-selected fixed values; fresh check prompts are not used to retune.
